If you're calling hardware based code, you're left with one of two choices:

  2. Use Python and just call them with a single line of code.

If it didn't mean having to do all of that, I'd never use Python ever again.

I know there are, but not with the same hardware-based libraries. It's just a matter of calling a library to run Terminal/DOS/Powershell commands instead of writing your own. It's a matter of calling a library for GPIO input/output. It's a matter of calling a library to multithread.
